description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder, which is responsible for building an interchange schema object from directory files and hashes, parsing configuration directives, and managing related data structures in the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder
classes.description: Builder class responsible for constructing an HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange object from directory files and hashes, handling parsing, validation, and directive creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the builder with an optional varParser or default to a new HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native instance.

methods.name: buildFromDirectory
methods.description: Static method to create an interchange object by reading all relevant schema files from a specified directory.

methods.name: buildDir
methods.description: Builds the interchange schema from a directory, reading 'info.ini' and schema text files, then processing each file.

methods.name: buildFile
methods.description: Parses a specific file and incorporates its data into the interchange schema.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the interchange from a given hash, validating the presence of required IDs, and deciding whether to process a directive or handle errors.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Creates a directive object from the parsed hash and adds it to the interchange schema.

methods.name: evalArray
methods.description: Evaluates a string containing array syntax into an array, avoiding the array() wrapper.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Converts a list of values into a hash for quick lookup.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Creates an interchange ID object from a string ID.

methods.name: _findUnused
methods.description: Checks for any keys in the hash that were not accessed during building, issuing warnings for unused keys.
